name: Origin Dollar
oneLiner: OUSD is Origin Protocol's yield-bearing rebasing USDC wrapper; deposits are deployed across Morpho and Curve strategies and yield is paid via rebase.
collateral: USDC deployed into DeFi strategies (Morpho, Curve)
pegMechanism: Minted 1:1 against USDC into the OUSD Vault, which deploys backing into Morpho lending and a Curve OUSD/USDC AMO; $1 par is held by 1:1 Vault redemption to USDC (a ~10 minute buffer delay, up to 24 hours when the buffer needs to be refilled) plus instant Curve AMO swap arbitrage. Yield is distributed via daily rebasing.

assets.name: USDC deployed through Origin OUSD strategies

mintAuthority.summary: OUSD is minted 1:1 when users deposit USDC into the Origin OUSD Vault, but the protocol also runs a Curve AMO that pre-mints OUSD into protocol-owned liquidity and deploys USDC into Morpho/Curve strategies under privileged owner/Governor/Strategist roles.

controls.label: OUSD Vault (user mint/redeem)
controls.evidence: Users mint OUSD by depositing USDC to the Vault and redeem 1:1; the Vault contract gates the user mint/redeem flow and deploys backing into Morpho/Curve strategies.

controls.label: Origin Governor / Strategist (AMO + strategy admin)
controls.evidence: Origin governance whitelists strategies and authorizes the Strategist/Guardian to allocate Vault USDC; the Curve AMO uses mintForStrategy/burnForStrategy to pre-mint protocol-owned OUSD that is collateralized on swap, a privileged supply-control path beyond user deposits.

review.evidence: Origin docs and the OpenZeppelin audit describe a Vault-based 1:1 mint/redeem plus a Curve AMO that pre-mints OUSD (mintForStrategy/burnForStrategy) into protocol-owned liquidity, governed by privileged owner/Strategist/Harvester roles, so this is an AMO/strategy hybrid rather than a pure single-parent wrapper or backend issuer.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the live owner/Governor/Strategist addresses (timelock vs multisig) and current AMO strategy whitelist before raising confidence.
